title: Risk & Compliance Analyst
description: We are a fast-growing B2B fintech startup simplifying how businesses manage collections, payouts, and financial operations. As we continue to scale, we are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Risk & Compliance Executive to strengthen our risk framework and help safeguard our payments ecosystem. If you have a keen eye for identifying risks, enjoy investigative work, and are passionate about building a secure and compliant financial ecosystem, this is your opportunity to make an impact. Join us in building trust, strengthening controls, and shaping the future of secure digital payments! Key Responsibilities Business KYC & Business Onboarding Review and verify business onboarding documents for authenticity, accuracy, and regulatory completeness in accordance with applicable regulatory guidelines. Examine corporate incorporation records, constitutional documents, statutory registrations, tax-related records, and other supporting business documents. Cross-verify company details, registration status, ownership information, and business particulars through official government portals and authorised public databases. Validate the nature of business, ownership structure, registered address, website/application, business model, and intended use of financial services. Conduct enhanced due diligence (EDD) as part of every new business onboarding to assess business legitimacy and identify potential risk factors. Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, or potential red flags and maintain proper verification records and audit trails. AML & Transaction Monitoring Monitor transactions to identify suspicious, unusual, or potentially fraudulent activities. Conduct AML assessments by analysing transaction patterns, frequency, volume, counterparties, and deviations from expected business activity. Perform risk-based assessments to identify unusual transaction behaviour, potential layering, fund circulation, and other suspicious patterns. Support AML screening, alert investigation, and business risk scoring, including identification of potential sanctions, adverse media, and other relevant risk indicators. Review and investigate transaction alerts, document findings, and determine whether activities require further scrutiny or escalation. Identify potential fraud patterns, unusual fund flows, and emerging financial crime risks. Escalate suspicious activities and potential compliance breaches in line with internal protocols and applicable regulatory requirements. Maintain proper records of AML assessments, investigation outcomes, and alert resolutions. Regulatory & Compliance Support Assist in applicable RBI, NPCI, UPI, and payment gateway compliance activities. Support policy execution relating to transaction monitoring, risk assessment, compliance reporting, and internal audits. Maintain evidence and documentation for compliance reviews, regulatory assessments, and banking partner due diligence. Reporting & Process Governance Prepare and maintain KYC trackers, risk registers, alert resolution logs, and compliance MIS. Contribute to strengthening internal risk frameworks and SOPs. Skills & Competencies Detailed understanding of Business KYC, business verification, and compliance processes. Familiarity with corporate documentation, statutory records, and government verification portals. Ability to analyse transaction behaviour and identify irregularities. Understanding of AML assessment, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity identification. Strong attention to detail and structured thinking. Good communication and stakeholder coordination. Comfortable working with compliance trackers, dashboards, and reports. Integrity and ability to handle confidential information responsibly. Must-Have Traits High discretion in handling sensitive information. Strong ownership and accountability. Ability to work with SOPs and tight deadlines. Compliance-first mindset. Qualification Bachelor's degree in any field (Finance/Commerce/Business is preferred but not mandatory). Experience 1–2 years in corporate KYC, business verification, risk monitoring, AML, compliance, or operations. Exposure to payments, fintech, banking, or financial services compliance is an added advantage. Who Will Excel Here Enjoys compliance, verification, and investigation work. Has an eye for spotting discrepancies and anomalies. Wants to grow in the Fintech Risk & Compliance space. Values structured processes, accountability, and ownership. title: Data Science Analyst
description: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. # About the team and the role **The Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) team** focuses on making selling on eBay simple, fast, and rewarding for everyday sellers, from listing and shipping to getting paid and selling again. C2C is a key growth engine for eBay: it brings unique inventory to the marketplace, and sellers who also buy drive significantly more demand across the platform. The team works to grow and retain the C2C seller base, improve selling velocity, and strengthen this buyer–seller flywheel. **In this role** in the Indian Analytics Centre, you will be a hands-on analytics partner for C2C product initiatives. You will take well-scoped and moderately ambiguous product questions, break them down into clear analyses, and turn your findings into crisp insights and recommendations. Working closely with senior analysts and the analytics manager, you will build strong product and data depth in C2C and grow towards independently owning larger problem spaces. The role suits someone who is curious, self-driven, and eager to take ownership of their work. # What you will accomplish Own analytics for defined C2C workstreams Measure how C2C product changes move core outcomes such as seller growth, listings, sold items, and incremental GMV, and help identify the levers that make C2C sellers more successful. Break down product and business questions into structured analyses with clear hypotheses and success metrics, with guidance on scoping for broader or more ambiguous problems. Use strong SQL and analytical rigour to analyse customer behaviour, product performance, feature adoption, funnels, and cohorts across large datasets. Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insights and recommendations for product managers and working teams, and contribute to narratives shared with senior stakeholders. Partner with product, engineering, design, and peer analytics teams on day-to-day questions, and keep stakeholders informed on progress, findings, and risks. Support measurement for product tests and launches, including defining metrics, building dashboards, monitoring performance, and diagnosing changes. Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that enable consistent performance tracking and self-service. Look beyond the immediate ask, flag anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities in the data, and bring them to the team with a point of view. Maintain high analytical quality by following clear metric definitions, validating data, documenting assumptions, and having work reviewed before it is shared. # What you will bring ## Required qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field. 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related role, ideally in a product or consumer technology setting. Strong hands-on SQL skills and experience analysing large, imperfect datasets with accuracy and attention to detail. Experience in product or business analytics, such as funnel analysis, customer journey analysis, feature adoption, segmentation, or performance measurement. Ability to build clear, user-friendly dashboards and data visualisations using BI or analytics tools. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals and experiment measurement. Good critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to question assumptions and understand the real question behind an ask. Ability to communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, and to present analysis confidently to product and cross-functional partners. Self-driven and proactive working style, with a strong sense of ownership and the willingness to ask questions, raise issues, and move work forward. Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards for data quality and timely delivery. An AI-first mindset and interest in using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical productivity and synthesis. ## Good to have Working knowledge of Python for exploratory analysis, automation, or prototyping. Exposure to causal inference or quasi-experimental methods. Experience with product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools. Experience in e-commerce, online marketplaces, seller or creator platforms, or consumer technology. Additional Details eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status.
